en.headline: Free harbourfront shows continue as arts expo opens Friday
en.dek: The Hong Kong Performing Arts Expo runs from 9 to 13 October, with free outdoor performances at the Cultural Centre plaza each afternoon through Friday.
body: Free outdoor performances on the Tsim Sha Tsui harbourfront continue through Friday as the second Hong Kong Performing Arts Expo prepares to open on 9 October.

The Hong Kong Arts Development Council said the prologue runs from 6 to 9 October at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre outdoor plaza, daily from 4:30pm to 7:30pm, with free admission. The programme covers dance, Cantonese opera, music and choral work by local and visiting artists. Wednesday's slot is presented by Chun Fai Cantonese Opera Workshop, with opera excerpts and a segment from the dance drama Qiuci.

The expo itself runs from 9 to 13 October under the theme of performing arts in motion. A public performance of the opening work My City is set for 8pm on Thursday in the Cultural Centre Theatre. Standard tickets are HK$280 and concession tickets HK$140, on sale through URBTIX.

Two further ticketed shows, the Hungarian circus-dance piece Paradisum and the Chilean play An Isolated Case, are scheduled for Sunday afternoon at the East Kowloon Cultural Centre. Partner programmes run at venues across the city from 7 to 13 October and again from 16 to 18 October, with separate ticketing.
The council said the first expo, in 2024, drew more than 1,600 cultural leaders and artists from 60 places and recorded more than 32,000 attendances by industry participants and audiences.

zh.headline: 演藝博覽周五開幕 文化中心露天廣場免費演出至周五
zh.dek: 第二屆香港演藝博覽10月9日至13日舉行，序幕節目由周二起至周五每日下午4時半至7時半在文化中心露天廣場免費演出。
body: 第二屆香港演藝博覽周五開幕前，尖沙咀海濱的免費戶外演出會一直排到周五。香港藝術發展局表示，序幕節目10月6日至9日在香港文化中心露天廣場舉行，每日下午4時30分至7時30分，免費入場。
節目包括本地及外地藝術家的舞蹈、粵劇、音樂及合唱。周三場次由春暉粵藝工作坊呈獻粵劇選段，以及舞劇《龜茲》選段《般若世界》。
博覽本屆由10月9日至13日舉行，主題為「演藝躍動」。開幕演出《我城》的公開場次定於周四晚上8時在文化中心劇場上演，正價門票280元，優惠票140元，經城市售票網發售。
另外兩場售票演出、匈牙利馬戲舞蹈作品《天境重生》及智利劇場作品《純屬個別事件》，周日下午在東九文化中心上演。伙伴節目則於10月7日至13日及16日至18日在多個場地舉行，須另行購票。
藝發局表示，2024年首屆博覽有來自60個地方、逾1600名文化領袖及藝術工作者參與，同業及觀眾參與人次超過32000。
